verdicts.trajectory_on_off: POSITIVE (accept pending user decision - small but consistent: covered MAE -0.0107, 9/11 LOPO pairs win, all four class buckets improve)

data_quality_fix: Pre-req bug fix shipped first: player_on_off OFF rates used nullif(x,0), which passes ~1e-13 float-residual possession sums while integer points stay nonzero, minting ~1e16 ratings (4 rows >1e6; ~27 rows |net|>1000). Plus 6 seasons (2016-2018, 2021-2023) carried stale rows predating the on/off rewrite's >=100-possession ON gate. Fix: >=10-possession floor on OFF-rate denominators in compute.rs + full 11-season recompute. Post-fix: 0 rows |net|>1000 (max 259), 0 rows below the ON gate, 17 honest NULL-net iron-men.

game_models.setup: shared chronological last-20%-of-2026 holdout (n=925), 12-season train (n=46791), production hyperparams, matrix built once with LINEUP_FEATURES=1, baseline = column subset
game_models.features: diff_lu_hhi (possession HHI over 5-man lineups to date), diff_lu_top_share (most-used lineup's possession share), diff_lu_top_net (its net rating per 100, >=20-poss floor) - expanding-window, shift-one-game leak-free, 5-man stints only
game_models.coverage: 91-100% of kept rows every season except 2019 (0% - no lineups)
game_models.note: All 7 holdout metrics degrade. Same trap as Tier-1: the 3 diffs ranked 10/11/15 of 52 by importance while accuracy dropped - importance is not value. Earlier best_iter (347->269) suggests the features accelerate overfit. Continuity/concentration is either absorbed by AdjEM/roster channels or not predictive at game level.

trajectory.setup: LOPO over 11 pairs, identical corpus (n=24,592), -999 missing sentinel, run AFTER the on/off bug fix + 11-season recompute
trajectory.note: First positive PBP-feature verdict across Tier-1 + Tier-2: consistent direction (9/11 pairs, monotone improvement in every class bucket) where every rejected family was flat-to-negative with ~5/11 wins. On/off carries team-context impact evidence the box score and CamPom genuinely lack. Magnitude is modest (~0.5% relative); shipping costs a trajectory-contract change (48->51 features, retrain + ONNX re-export + Rust TRAJECTORY_FEATURE_NAMES + serving-side player_on_off lookup with sentinel fill) - a separate PR if accepted.

disposition: lineup_quality closes for game models (LINEUP_FEATURES plumbing kept gated off in features.py; experiment script kept as re-test harness, e.g. when natstat exact-membership coverage matures). Trajectory on/off is the candidate to ship. RAPM remains open as the principled membership play - this verdict pair sharpens its prior: player-level membership signal has value (trajectory accept-leaning), team-level continuity summaries do not (game reject).
